services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Choose from one of our great charter packages or create a custom charter package with the help of our captain. At, Reel-istic Fishing Charters, it is our goal to go above and beyond to make your Outer Banks fishing experience exciting and enjoyable. Our charters include full day trips (8 hours), 3/4 day trips (6 hours), and 1/2 day trips (4 hours). If these do not work for you and your crew, we are happy to work with you and create a custom package that fits your needs and wants. "Booked a trip on 10/5/18! Amazing day!!! So blessed!!! Capt. Brian knows his business!!!! Highly recommend!!!!" - Robert "Great trip out today with Brian. Would recommend to anyone visiting OBX!!" -

blurb: Guests join Captain Brian for fishing charters in the Outer Banks targeting species such as Red Drum, Speckled Trout, Sheepshead, and Striped Bass. Charters offered include half day, three-quarter day, full day, shark, and night drum fishing trips. The captain is professional and courteous, aiming to provide the best fishing and outdoor experience.
